title: Go Fast email deleted under the spillage protocol
summary: Tim Gallaudet tells of Go Fast email deleted under the spillage protocol, about c. 2015 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the story he told me what happened is when it was deleted they were still not sure whether it was adversary tech or or off-world

plain: Tim Gallaudet, a retired US Navy admiral, says that a Navy official named Jay Stratton told him about an email carrying the Go Fast video, a Navy clip of a small object speeding low over the ocean, around 2015. According to Stratton's account, the email was deleted from Navy networks under the spillage protocol, the rule for wiping secret material sent to the wrong place, at a time when officials still were not sure whether the object was a rival nation's technology or something from off-world. If true, it would mean evidence was erased while the question was still open.
